title: The Priestly Garments

questions.question: Who was set apart for the priesthood?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:1 (ESV): "Bring near to you Aaron your brother, and his sons with him... to serve me as priests."

questions.question: What was the breastpiece of the high priest called?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:15 (ESV): "You shall make a breastpiece of judgment."

questions.question: How many precious stones were on the breastpiece?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:21 (ESV): "There shall be twelve stones with their names according to the names of the sons of Israel."

questions.question: What was engraved on the gold plate on Aaron's turban?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:36 (ESV): "You shall make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet, 'Holy to the Lord.'"

questions.question: What was the purpose of the priestly garments?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:2 (ESV): "You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty."

questions.question: What was the ephod made of?
options: Gold, blue, purple, scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, blue, purple, scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:6 (ESV): "They shall make the ephod of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and of fine twined linen."

questions.question: What stones were set on the shoulder pieces of the ephod?
options: Two onyx stones engraved with the names of Israel's sons
questions.correctAnswer: Two onyx stones engraved with the names of Israel's sons
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:9-10 (ESV): "You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel."

questions.question: What were the Urim and Thummim?
options: Objects placed in the breastpiece for making decisions
questions.correctAnswer: Objects placed in the breastpiece for making decisions
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:30 (ESV): "You shall put in the breastpiece of judgment the Urim and the Thummim... and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the people of Israel."

questions.question: What color was the robe of the ephod?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:31 (ESV): "You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue."

questions.question: What were attached to the hem of the robe?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:33 (ESV): "On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet yarns... with bells of gold between them."

questions.question: Why were bells on Aaron's robe important?
options: So he would be heard when going into the Holy Place and not die
questions.correctAnswer: So he would be heard when going into the Holy Place and not die
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:35 (ESV): "Its sound shall be heard when he goes into the Holy Place before the Lord, and when he comes out, so that he does not die."

questions.question: What were Aaron's four sons called?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:1 (ESV): "Aaron your brother, and his sons with him... Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar."

questions.question: What purpose did the gold plate serve?
options: Aaron shall bear any guilt from the holy things so the people may be accepted
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron shall bear any guilt from the holy things so the people may be accepted
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:38 (ESV): "It shall be on Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear any guilt from the holy things."

questions.question: What undergarment was made for the priests?
options: Linen undergarments to cover their nakedness
questions.correctAnswer: Linen undergarments to cover their nakedness
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:42 (ESV): "You shall make for them linen undergarments to cover their naked flesh."

questions.question: What would happen if the priests did not wear proper garments?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:43 (ESV): "Lest they bear guilt and die."

key_verse_text: You shall make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet, 'Holy to the Lord.'
